label: D1 after an unrewarded common a2->S2 trial, while the policy moderately favours a2
explanation: Fires only at D1, and only when the reward input is 0, i.e. the previous trial went unrewarded (it never fires after reward, at GO, or at D2). Within that, about 82% of activation mass comes after the previous trial was a2 with a common transition to S2; on the first trial of a window, where prev_action is unknown, it is also permissive. The predicate (D1, prev unrewarded, prev a2 common or unknown) has 97% mass recall but only 0.20 precision. Adding a band on the model policy logit at D1 (choice between -4.44 and -1.52, a moderate lean towards a2) raises dev precision to 0.46 with 0.91 mass recall (F1 0.62). It fires more when the agent is choosing a2 while S1 is good (chose_good=0, 2.7x) and in mid-to-late episode trials, and value is in the middle range (5.2-7.5). So it reads as an S2-just-failed signal that is gated by the current a2 preference. Only observed variables and the model policy readout are used. Precision stays incomplete: many D1 steps that match these conditions do not cross the threshold, and magnitude was not analysed beyond the quartile coverage, which is flat.
